_comment: Security-sensitive curated project and go-to-market configuration for the SemiSkill command centre. Live signals (git, DB, tests, inbox) are merged by dashboard/server.py. Changes require the normal reviewed repository workflow plus an updated adjacent integrity pin; prompt text becomes separate-worker input.

project.name: SemiSkill
project.one_liner: No skill becomes discoverable until it passes a six-stage security pipeline and a human approval gate. The catalog is written only by the approval actuator — never by a submitter.

layers.name: Capture / Sourcing
layers.role: Ingest submissions, comments, ratings, reuse → raw captured artifacts

layers.name: Spine + Artifacts
layers.role: Append-only store + five-class event spine + derived lifecycle

layers.name: Context
layers.role: ACL-enforced catalog search / lineage / reuse (+ read API)

layers.name: Intelligence
layers.role: Stability gate + queue ranking + model routing

pipeline_stages.name: Security audit
pipeline_stages.coverage: opt-in runner; visible skip when absent
pipeline_stages.detail: Wires cloudflare/security-audit-skill via an injectable runner. Live run needs an egress sandbox + claude-flow — tested with an injected runner.

pipeline_stages.name: Held-out injection corpus
pipeline_stages.detail: Corpus lives outside anything a pipeline agent can read or modify (semiskill_pipeline role is denied).

pipeline_stages.name: Secret / PII
pipeline_stages.detail: Credential shapes, internal URLs, PII patterns — hard-fail on live secret material.

pipeline_stages.name: Calibrated LLM judge
pipeline_stages.detail: κ-calibrated, drift-monitored, cross-family guard. Live judge needs ANTHROPIC/OPENAI keys — FakeJudge tested end-to-end.

pipeline_stages.name: Aggregate verdict
pipeline_stages.detail: Worst-stage safety wins; hard-fail short-circuits so no later stage runs and the skill can never advance.

features.name: SKILL.md intake → skill_version
features.note: YAML frontmatter (ADR-007), untrusted body, NUL-byte hardening.

features.name: Comment / rating / reuse event builders

features.name: Canonical artifact schema
features.note: ADR-001 — provenance, permissions, objective, eval_score, rollback_ref.

features.name: Append-only store (no UPDATE path)
features.note: Corrections append a new row; history is never rewritten.

features.name: Five-class event spine
features.note: Captured → Analyzed → Proposed → Executed → Observed.

features.name: Derived lifecycle state machine
features.note: State is derived from artifacts, never stored — cannot be forged.

features.name: Migrations 0001–0008 + runner
features.note: artifacts → context → pipeline → corpus → publish → cost → detail.

features.name: Row-level ACL (semiskill_app denied direct reads)
features.note: Three DB roles: app / submitter / pipeline.

features.name: ACL-enforced faceted catalog search
features.note: Published-only; need-to-know is invisible, not redacted-visible.

features.name: Lineage + reuse graph (ACL-pruned)
features.note: Full verification trail per skill version.

features.name: Untrusted-content delimiting + redaction
features.note: Skill bodies are treated as injection payloads at retrieval time.

features.name: Read API (/catalog /skill /queue /lineage /reuse)
features.note: Dependency-free stdlib server; read-only by construction.

features.name: pgvector semantic search
features.note: Deferred — needs Voyage embedding egress. Postgres FTS is used instead.

features.name: 6-stage pipeline orchestrator
features.note: Hard-fail short-circuits; every stage writes a scan artifact.

features.name: Action gate (deny-precedence + fail-closed audit)
features.note: Blocked action cannot run — audit write precedes execution.

features.name: Tool allowlist policy
features.note: Bash/Exec class tools hard-fail at stage 1.

features.name: Gated publish actuator
features.note: ADR-002 — re-checks verdict + no hard-fail in chain before writing the catalog.

features.name: Rollback / unpublish drill
features.note: Re-verified in Phase F; active-approval-wins catalog.

features.name: Governance + calibration (κ) report
features.note: Posture: egress, roles, tools, cost.

features.name: Six-control stability gate
features.note: No oscillation; deny-precedence.

features.name: Risk-first review-queue ranking
features.note: Lowest aggregate safety surfaces first.

features.name: Model routing + budget gate + cost/verified-skill
features.note: Cheap models for bounded scans; escalate on ambiguity.

features.name: Auto-approve (no human in loop)
features.note: Deliberately human-gated until calibration proves otherwise. Not a gap.

features.name: Stage 2 live security-audit runner
features.note: Injectable runner tested + visible skip. Live run needs egress sandbox + claude-flow.

features.name: Stage 3 held-out injection corpus
features.note: Corpus unreadable by the pipeline role — verified by test.

features.name: Stage 5 live calibrated judge
features.note: κ calibration, drift, cross-family guard all tested with FakeJudge. Live judge needs API keys.

features.name: Red-team harness and input corpus
features.note: Harness tests and adversarial inputs exist; no immutable execution result is bound to the current corpus.

features.name: Catalog UI (verification-badge-centric)
features.note: Demonstrable HTML artifact + Next.js/shadcn scaffold. Not built/deployed (needs npm).

features.name: SharePoint tenant embedding
features.note: Needs an M365 tenant. Hosting model chosen; embedding unproven.

features.name: Entra ID / SSO principal binding
features.note: Verified bearer/group resolution is implemented and caller-supplied labels are ignored. Production remains fail-closed until tenant issuer, tenant ID and resolver credentials are configured.

features.name: Comment / rating / reuse write UI
features.note: Artifacts exist; there is no user-facing path to create them.

features.name: Approver console (queue → approve/reject)
features.note: Queue is served read-only; approval is a Python call today.

features.name: Notifications (submit → verdict → publish)
features.note: No email/Teams hook. Blocks the author feedback loop.

features.name: Deployment target + runbook
features.note: Local Docker Postgres only (ADR-005). No hosted environment.

features.name: Backup / restore + retention
features.note: Append-only store with no backup policy is a single point of loss.

features.name: Observability (this command centre)
features.note: Repo/DB/test signals are live here. No metrics store or alerting yet.

features.name: CI (tests on every push)
features.note: Suite is green locally; nothing runs it automatically.

risks.title: Production identity configuration pending
risks.detail: The API verifies resolver-derived groups and ignores caller-supplied labels, but no production Entra tenant is configured. Production therefore fails closed.
risks.mitigation: Configure and validate the approved Entra issuer, tenant and resolver credentials before any multi-user pilot.

risks.title: Two of six scan stages are stubs in production terms
risks.detail: Stage 2 (security-audit) and stage 5 (LLM judge) run against injected fakes. Verdict quality claims rest on the four deterministic stages.
risks.mitigation: Provision egress sandbox + API keys; re-run calibration before claiming κ.

risks.title: Nothing is deployed
risks.detail: Everything runs on one workstation against local Docker Postgres. There is no environment a colleague can reach.
risks.mitigation: F-OPS-01 — pick a host, write the runbook.

risks.title: No CI, no backups
risks.detail: Green tests depend on a human running pytest; the append-only store has no restore path.

risks.title: Author feedback loop is not closed
risks.detail: A submitter gets no notification of a verdict and cannot see why they were blocked without DB access.
risks.mitigation: F-PRD-06 + submitter view of the scan report.

risks.title: Current phase is design-verification only
risks.detail: The fixed registry contains 84 active DV skills; broader taxonomy expansion is deliberately deferred until this release passes its canonical gate.
risks.mitigation: Finish the 84-skill release before planning any additional taxonomy.

risks.title: False-positive rate unmeasured on real submissions
risks.detail: The current red-team escape result is unavailable; the block rate on honest skills is also unmeasured, and over-blocking kills adoption.
risks.mitigation: Persist corpus-bound red-team results and instrument block-rate + appeal rate from day one of the pilot.

gtm.positioning: For engineering organisations that have banned Agent Skills because one bad skill is a data-exfiltration vector, SemiSkill is an internal marketplace where verification is a precondition of publishing — so teams get the sharing upside without the prompt-injection downside. Unlike a wiki, a shared drive, or public skills.sh, the catalog is written only by a gated approval actuator and every action is an immutable, ACL-labeled artifact.

icp.why: Already blocked from using skills; high-leverage repeated workflows (RTL, DV, DFT, PD, low-power, SoC arch); strong IP-secrecy constraints that make public sharing impossible.
icp.entry: DV guild — highest skill reuse per engineer.

icp.why: Software, firmware, data, IT — same policy blocker, same artifact model, zero extra platform work.
icp.entry: Piggyback on the DV launch announcement.

icp.why: Finance/health/defence teams face the identical ban. The security model is the product.
icp.entry: Open-source the scanner core, sell the governed catalog.

actions.label: Build the approver console
actions.prompt: Build the approver console: a small UI + write endpoint over the review queue so a human approver can approve or reject a skill version from the browser, going through governance.publish.publish_skill (never a direct catalog write). Write the failing test first.

actions.label: Author scan-report view
actions.prompt: Give submitters a view of their own skill's scan report (per-stage findings + verdict + how to fix) via the read API, ACL-scoped so an author sees only their own submissions.

actions.label: Configure production Entra binding
actions.prompt: Configure the approved Entra issuer, tenant and resolver credentials for the existing verified bearer/group binding, then prove production fails closed for forged, missing and wrong-tenant claims.

actions.label: Comment / rating / reuse write path
actions.prompt: Add the write path for comments, ratings, and reuse events: API endpoints + tests, artifacts appended with correct provenance and permission labels. No catalog writes.

actions.label: Notifications on verdict + publish
actions.prompt: Add a notification hook so a submitter learns their verdict and a publish is announced. Keep it pluggable (no vendor lock) and test with a fake transport.

actions.label: After 84: plan taxonomy expansion
actions.prompt: Only after the current 84 DV skills are independently reviewed, explicitly approved and published, propose a separately gated plan for additional functions. Do not expand the current release scope.

actions.label: Build + serve the catalog UI
actions.prompt: Get ui/ actually building and served against the read API (npm install, build, run), replacing the static demo. Report anything that blocks.

actions.label: Live stage-2 security audit
actions.prompt: Wire the stage-2 security-audit scanner to a real runner inside an egress-controlled sandbox, and prove it runs on a submission end-to-end.

actions.label: Live stage-5 judge + recalibrate
actions.prompt: Wire a live Claude judge for stage 5, re-run the κ calibration against the held-out corpus, and report drift + agreement vs the FakeJudge baseline.

actions.label: Fresh red-team wave
actions.prompt: Generate a new wave of novel attack skills across all six attack classes, run them through the pipeline, and report any escape. Add survivors to the regression fixture.

actions.label: Threat model + diagram
actions.prompt: Write the threat model for SemiSkill (assets, actors, trust boundaries, attacks, controls) with a diagram, and fold it into docs/SECURITY.md.

actions.label: Set up CI
actions.prompt: Add CI that runs the full test suite (with a Postgres service) on every push, and report the result badge.

actions.label: Pick a deploy target + runbook
actions.prompt: Propose two deployment options for the artifact store + pipeline + read API given egress control, recommend one as an ADR, and write the runbook.

actions.label: Backup / restore policy
actions.prompt: Design and implement backup + restore for the append-only artifact store, including a restore drill with verification.

actions.label: Instrument the funnel
actions.prompt: Instrument the product funnel (browsed → activated → contributed → published → habitual) as artifacts, and expose a metrics endpoint this dashboard can chart live.

actions.label: Write the launch blog post
actions.prompt: Write the launch blog post: why agent skills were banned, what a malicious skill actually does, the gate, the red-team results, and how to get started. Save it to marketing/launch-post.md.

actions.label: Demo video script + storyboard
actions.prompt: Write a 3-minute demo video script + shot list: submit → malicious skill blocked → fix → published → reused. Save to marketing/demo-script.md.

actions.label: Launch social thread
actions.prompt: Write a 6-post LinkedIn/X thread on the security architecture (the ban, the risk, the gate, the red team, the results, the invite). Save to marketing/social-thread.md.

actions.label: Guild demo deck
actions.prompt: Build an 8-slide guild demo deck that ends in the live demo, using the ppt/slides skill. Save it under marketing/.

actions.label: Messaging one-pager
actions.prompt: Write the positioning + messaging one-pager (problem, mechanism, proof, ask, objections) and save to marketing/one-pager.md.

actions.label: Recruit design partners
actions.prompt: Draft the design-partner recruitment plan + outreach message for 3 engineering guilds: what they get, what we need from them, and the 2-week commitment.

actions.label: ROI calculator
actions.prompt: Build an ROI calculator (reuse events × minutes saved × loaded cost) as a small self-contained page under marketing/.

actions.label: Objection-handling FAQ
actions.prompt: Write the objection-handling FAQ: why not a wiki, what if the scanner is wrong, who owns the skill, what about false positives, what does it cost. Save to marketing/faq.md.

actions.label: Pricing / packaging ADR
actions.prompt: Write an ADR proposing pricing and packaging for the external track, with the internal-free decision made explicit.

actions.label: Weekly metrics report
actions.prompt: Produce this week's metrics report from the artifact store: submissions, blocks, publishes, reuse, time-to-publish, cost per verified skill — and flag anything moving the wrong way.

actions.label: Measure block rate / false positives
actions.prompt: Measure the block rate on honest submissions vs the red-team corpus, estimate the false-positive rate, and propose scanner tuning if over-blocking.

actions.label: Request isolated full-suite verification
actions.prompt: Run the full suite serially against the exact isolated *_test database. Bind the result to the current commit, source tree, and database identity; persist pass, fail, skip, xpass, and duration evidence. Never run concurrently or against the development catalog.

actions.label: Code review the whole build
actions.prompt: Review the codebase for bugs, security holes, and convention drift, and report findings ranked by severity.

actions.label: Close a gap I pick
actions.prompt: Pick the highest-leverage open gap on the dashboard, tell me why, and close it end-to-end with tests.

actions.label: Propose refreshed dashboard data
actions.prompt: Re-derive proposed dashboard model changes from current source-bound evidence (features, tests, gaps, risks) and prepare a reviewable patch only. Do not update the integrity pin or activate the changed prompt library; a separate reviewer or human must approve the exact model bytes and provenance before activation.

actions.label: Investigate database availability
actions.prompt: Diagnose why the dashboard cannot observe the configured database. Perform read-only identity and health checks first; do not start containers, mutate schemas, or use a development database for test execution. Return evidence and a proposed recovery action.

actions.label: Review the highest-priority architecture decision
actions.prompt: Review the highest-priority active SemiSkill architecture decision against the current implementation and launch contract. Propose a qualifying or superseding ADR only when evidence requires it; preserve append-only decision history.

actions.label: Improve the highest-priority verification stage
actions.prompt: Identify the highest-priority incomplete or weak verification stage, write a failing adversarial test, implement the smallest correct hardening, and attach source-bound evidence without crediting unexecuted checks.

actions.label: Advance the next launch-planning item
actions.prompt: Select the highest-weight incomplete item in the curated launch-planning register and advance its evidence-backed work. Then verify the separate deterministic release_gate snapshot; this request confers no launch credit and must not mark any item complete without source-bound proof.

actions.label: Produce the next evidence-backed launch asset
actions.prompt: Select the next missing launch asset and produce a draft using only authoritative current product evidence. Keep unavailable metrics and outcomes explicitly unavailable; do not fabricate publication, red-team, adoption, pricing, or customer proof.

actions.label: Advance the next go-to-market channel
actions.prompt: Select the next proposed go-to-market channel, state the unvalidated hypothesis, and prepare the smallest concrete experiment or asset. Do not contact external parties or claim measured impact without separate human authorization and evidence.
